trial_court: Family Court no.4, Ahmedabad in Hindu Marriage Petition (HMP) no.1725 of 2018
case_name: Niral W/O Ankit Shah And D/O ... v. Ankit Rajendrabhai Shah

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Niral W/O Ankit Shah And D/O JITENDRABHAI JAYANTIBHAI GARIWALA (wife)

facts_of_case: The parties were in a marriage that was dissolved by the trial court. The petitioner sought divorce under Section 13(1) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955, but the application was dismissed. The parties have since settled and agreed to a mutual divorce.

legal_principles.principle: Parties can withdraw a petition and file an application for divorce by mutual consent.
legal_principles.held: The said fact is evident from Paragraph 9 of the affidavit filed by the respondent herein.

legal_principles.principle: The court may grant permission to withdraw a petition and file an application for divorce by mutual consent.

outcome.final_order: The appeal is permitted to withdraw the Hindu Marriage Petition no.1725 of 2018. The parties are at liberty to approach the Family Court, Ahmedabad with an application for divorce by mutual consent.

keywords: Latin maxim: Nemo judex in causa sua
